description: For distinct nonzero finite-error classes with pairwise zero meets, any supplied representatives form an almost disjoint family, without repetitions, whose image is exactly the original class family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.representatives_almostDisjoint
  (Q : Set Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.FiniteQuotient) (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, q ≠ ⊥)
  (hd : Q.Pairwise fun q r => q ⊓ r = ⊥) (r : ↑Q → Set ℕ)
  (hr :
    ∀ (q : ↑Q),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ) (r q) =
        ↑q) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint (Set.range r) ∧
    Function.Injective r ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ) ''
          Set.range r =
        Q
